title: Why Did My Optimum Bill Go Up? What Changed in 2026
description: Why your Optimum bill went up: promo step-ups, the May 2026 rate card, equipment, TV surcharges and lost Auto Pay discounts, with dates and sources.
h1: Why did my Optimum bill go up?
lead: What changed on Optimum bills, how to find the line that rose, and what to do about it.
short_answer: An Optimum bill usually goes up when a promotion steps up, reported at $15 a month in year two and again in year three, or when equipment, TV surcharges or a lost Auto Pay discount hit the bill. Optimum's current rate card for customers who joined on or before January 7, 2024 took effect May 18, 2026.

head: When
What changed
Who it affects
Source
rows: Optimum's Legacy Plus rate card took effect. It lists standard internet rates of $94.99 to $144.99 a month in most cable markets, a $6.00 Network Enhancement Fee for internet customers (select offers excluded) and a $14.00 Wireless Gateway. Optimum does not say what changed from the previous card.
Customers whose service began on or before January 7, 2024

On plans without a long price lock, the price is reported to rise $15 a month around month 13 and another $15 around month 25, for example $35, then $45, then $60, until it reaches Optimum's standard rate.
Customers who joined on a 12-month promotion

Optimum launched $25 a month 300 Mbps fiber with the price locked for five years. CableTV.com reports a 5-year price lock on new internet plans, though CompareInternet lists some plans with a 1-year lock. CableTV.com says that after the lock the price can rise up to $15 a month per year.
New customers. Older accounts are not covered unless moved to a new plan.

Reviewers report a $9.99 broadcast TV fee and a $10.47 regional sports fee on current TV plans. The Legacy Plus card lists a $15.00 Broadcast Station Programming Surcharge and a $6.65 Sports Programming Surcharge. In December 2025 Optimum publicly opposed station fee increases of about 30% sought by TEGNA for local network stations.

The Legacy Plus card lists $14.00 a month for a Wireless Gateway, DOCSIS modem or TV box, $5.00 per Optimum Extender and $10.00 for Whole Home WiFi. Reviewers say new plans include the gateway at no charge.

Promotional prices reportedly require Auto Pay and paperless billing from a checking account, worth $10 a month. Optimum also charges a $5.00 Payment Assistance Fee when you pay through an agent or by phone with a representative.
Customers who changed how they pay

sections.h2: How to find out why your Optimum bill went up
sections.body_html:
1. Check the second page of your monthly bill. Reviewers say Optimum puts notices of standard-rate changes there.
  2. Find your start date. If service began on or before January 7, 2024, your standard rates are on Optimum's Legacy Plus rate card at optimum.com/pricing. If it began January 8, 2024 or later, a separate New Offers rate card applies.
  3. Count the months since you signed up. A jump around month 13 or month 25 usually means a promotion stepped up.
  4. Compare the last two bills line by line: internet, Network Enhancement Fee, gateway and extenders, TV boxes, broadcast and sports surcharges, and any Payment Assistance Fee.
  5. Check that Auto Pay and paperless billing are still on. If the discount dropped off, the bill rises by that amount.

sections.h2: What you can do about it
sections.body_html:
1. If you joined before 2026, ask whether you can move to a current plan with a 5-year price lock. Optimum says moving Legacy customers to the New Offers card does not raise their price.
  2. Look for a Network Enhancement Fee line on your bill and ask about it if it appears. Reviewers say it no longer appears on Optimum's internet broadband labels.
  3. If you rent an Optimum gateway after the promo ended, ask whether current plans include it at no charge.
  4. Drop TV boxes you no longer use; each box adds a monthly charge.
  5. Pay online or through Auto Pay instead of by phone with an agent to avoid the $5.00 Payment Assistance Fee.

faq: Why did my Optimum bill go up $15?

On Optimum plans without a long price lock, reviewers report a $15 monthly increase around month 13 and another around month 25, until the standard rate is reached. Check your sign-up date and the notice on page two of your bill.

Optimum's Legacy Plus rate card for customers who started on or before January 7, 2024 took effect May 18, 2026. Optimum did not publish what changed. Optimum locks its $25 300 Mbps fiber plan for new customers for five years, and reviewers report 5-year locks on other new plans.
Does the Optimum 5-year price lock cover fees?
Optimum's March 2026 announcement does not list what the lock excludes. Ask before you switch whether taxes, the Network Enhancement Fee, equipment and TV surcharges can still change.
Can I get my old Optimum promo price back?
Not usually, but you can ask to move to a current plan. Optimum says Legacy customers moved to the New Offers rate card will not see a price increase because of the move.
